dct_description_sm: A relief map of Nova Scotia showing elevation by hypsometric tints (a gradation of different colours), and spot elevations. Major lakes are also shown. Elevation ranges are included in the map legend. The elevation data were derived from the map Canada-Relief, Fifth Edition, National Atlas of Canada published in 1986.

Fond de carte du Canada incluant les côtes, les frontières, les principaux lacs et cours d’eau du Canada et des régions environnantes. Comprend aussi les symboles des capitales et d’une sélection de lieux habités au Canada.
